utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, all. Friday, first of May. Everyone on? I've got seven little squares and about three ceilings.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, here. The heating in the portakabin is having a laugh. It's either tropical or absolutely Baltic.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's the temperature control: open the door, regret it, shut the door.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Pretty much. Anyway, that's a moan, not a maintenance request.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Before we start, the charity bake sale on Friday—that's today, despite what my brain says. Purely a reminder, no baking assignments.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. My contribution would need a COSHH sheet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quite. Right, yesterday's bits first, then the actual work.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I've already swapped the filter on the outfeed conveyor yesterday. That's finished, not something still hanging over today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely, closed off then.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I've already swapped the filter on the relief valve yesterday. Mine's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped there. That was completed yesterday, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, completed. Just reporting it, not asking for another go at it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: One observation: heard a slight rattle from the GT2 bearing, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, just an observation, rather than another job going on the board?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve. That one's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That's the delivery blocker, separate from the risk assessment for work on the GT2 inlet valve we'll come to.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah. No delivery confirmation, so no change there. I'm not adding a chasing job this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Also, the shutdown on the line 2 guard is cancelled now, production need it running.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: The guard shutdown specifically, yeah? Not wiping every line 2 item off?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly, just that shutdown. Cancelled, not parked as a job for later today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha Begum, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the line 2 next week? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Just so I don't muddle that with the cancelled shutdown—next week is the due point, but you want that treated as an immediate safety priority?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. Next week remains the due point. Straight away on priority; it doesn't mean isolate a running line right this second.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Understood. I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the line 2 next week. Safety critical, straight away on that basis.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, that distinction matters. A cancelled shutdown isn't permission to blur the permit boundaries.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Aisha Begum, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve after lunch? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve after lunch. Understood it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, I was talking over you—did that move to before lunch?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No, after lunch. Urgent, but the agreed timing is after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Davey, can you run a function test on the 11kV board this morning? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, accepted. I'll run a function test on the 11kV board this morning.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, normal priority, did you say? Audio went all underwater for a second.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Normal priority, yes. Not an emergency call-out.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's what I've got. This morning, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we're on spares, I'll order spare parts for the Water Booster Pump tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Tomorrow as in Saturday? Sorry, bank holiday weekend's scrambled everyone's calendar.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, tomorrow, Saturday. I'll order them then. Not promising delivery tomorrow, just the order.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marc. Ordering spare parts for the Water Booster Pump tomorrow, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona Doyle, can you clear the jam and check the sensors on the palletizer tomorrow at 9:30?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take that. Clear the jam and check the sensors on the palletizer tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, was that just the sensors? Teams swallowed the first half.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Both: clear the jam and check the sensors on the palletizer.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, both parts accepted. I've got tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I'll update the risk assessment for work on the GT2 inlet valve tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fiona. That risk assessment's not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Agreed. I'll update the risk assessment for work on the GT2 inlet valve tomorrow at 9:30. Not an emergency, but I won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You've got two against 9:30 there. Just checking that's deliberate, not me hearing an echo.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, deliberate. Both are mine at the agreed time. I'm not asking to move either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Last one: Grace Liu, can you take vibration readings on the line 3 barrel by Wednesday? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I can't take that one, sorry. I haven't got the capacity to commit to it by Wednesday. Better say no now than nod and miss it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sarah Okafor, could you take that instead?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take vibration readings on the line 3 barrel by Wednesday. Reassigned to me. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—understood.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks. So that's off me and with Sarah Okafor, definitely?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Definitely. I'll own it, not you.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The line 3 barrel, yeah? I'm getting every third noun this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: The line 3 barrel, yes. By Wednesday, with me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's the agreed work. Anything I've mistaken for a live job that was only a status update?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Just keep the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve delivery marked blocked. Still no supplier confirmation, no new action agreed on that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. Blocker only, not quietly allocating a chase to someone.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And the GT2 bearing rattle stays an observation. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Both yesterday's filter swaps are finished as well. No leftovers from those.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. A list that gets shorter as well as longer. Rare Friday treat.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Don't jinx it. Thanks, everyone. That's us—enjoy the cakes if there's anything left beyond crumbs.
